scope: Cleanup taxonomy only; no cleanup action is authorized or performed.

cleanup_classes.description: List, count, inspect, parse, compare, and summarize without writing.
cleanup_classes.publication_rule: Summaries only; no raw logs or sensitive content.

cleanup_classes.description: Create curated manifests, taxonomies, and candidate lists without modifying target files.
A proposed move, quarantine, archive, or rename that can be reversed.
cleanup_classes.publication_rule: Describe as proposal only with rollback plan.

cleanup_classes.description: Any deletion, recursive purge, history rewrite, cache purge, or permanent removal.
Any action changing GitHub, Google Drive, automation, cloud resources, accounts, or services.
cleanup_classes.publication_rule: Do not perform from this phase.

cleanup_classes.description: Raw logs, session JSONL, screenshots, and credential-bearing material are not staged or published.
cleanup_classes.publication_rule: Quarantine or ignore; never stage as phase artifact.

default_rule: If a candidate lacks ownership, retention class, approval status, and rollback plan, it remains observation-only.
